note: v429: Loan tab critique fixes. Recorded payments now track by DATE (each charged the rate in effect that day), so skipped, extra, or out-of-order payments reflect honestly on the calendar, progress bar, and schedule instead of being counted one-to-one. Tap a calendar day to see that payment's amount (tooltips were invisible on iPhone). Detail cards now lead with the next payment's amount and show interest paid so far. Friendlier save/delete error messages, a calculator hint in the editor, and small polish (empty-state icon, larger micro-labels).
